business_summary.text: Balkrishna Industries signed a strategic offtake and JV framework agreement with Pirelli to manufacture premium passenger car tyres at its Bhuj facility.

call_points.text: No additional capex is required for the offtake agreement as it utilizes the ongoing Bhuj PCR expansion.
Pricing for domestic supplies will be based on raw material actuals plus conversion cost.
Management reaffirmed that incremental revenues from the Pirelli agreement will be part of the existing 20% non-OHT revenue target by FY30.
Management maintained the long-term vision of ₹5,000 crores revenue in the on-highway segment by 2030.
No FY27 volume guidance; management said it stopped giving guidance due to geopolitical uncertainty.
Company aims to sustain blended EBITDA margins between 23% and 25% despite on-highway scale-up.
Carbon black Phase 2 to 360,000 MTPA is targeted on stream in Q1FY27; the new line is at full utilisation.
PCR tyres planned for launch by the end of the current calendar year, with first-phase capacity of 6,700 tyres per day.
call_points.versus_prior: moved from a Q3FY27 pilot to a launch by end of the calendar year

call_points.text: US was just short of 10% of FY26 volume; management targets returning to 10% in FY27.
Gross debt ₹4,049 crores and cash ₹3,154 crores at 31 March, giving net debt of ₹895 crores.
Management expects some margin pressure near term as raw material costs rise and pass-through is evaluated.
Board approved Deloitte Haskins & Sells as joint statutory auditor, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM.
Mix by FY30: ~70% OHT, ~20% on-highway, ~10% third-party carbon black sales.
OHT capacity to reach 425,000 MTPA via 35,000 MTPA capex and de-bottlenecking, for 8% global share.
Carbon black Phase 2 from 265,000 to 360,000 MTPA onstream in Q1FY27.
CRISIL rating upgraded to AA+/Stable from AA/Positive.

operating_notes.text: Company issued listed 75,000 unsecured non-convertible debentures of face value ₹1 lakh each aggregating ₹750 Cr on private placement basis during the quarter ended 31 March 2026.
Company repaid listed unsecured non-convertible debentures amounting to ₹150 Cr on due date during the year.
FY26 OHT sales volume 3,17,356 MT, up 1% YoY, with good recovery in H2 over H1 in Europe and improving traction in the Americas.
Carbon black Phase 1 capacity at 265,000 MTPA with a 24 MW cogeneration plant taking total co-gen power capacity to 64 MW at Bhuj.
FY26 standalone revenue ₹10,656 Cr was flat YoY after a ₹164 Cr realised forex loss versus a ₹202 Cr gain in FY25.
FY26 OHT sales volume was 317,356 MT, with Q4FY26 at 85,820 MT, up 5% YoY.
Carbon black third-party sales were about 9% of overall business in FY26; 30% of current capacity is consumed captively and around 70% sold in the market.
Freight cost was about 4.5-5% of revenue in Q4, expected to rise marginally; euro realisation was ~₹99 in Q4.
OHT market share: India about 18–19%, U.S. 3–4%, Europe 7–8%.
Carbon Black third-party sales were about 10% of overall business in Q1FY27.
Freight was about 5% of revenue; euro rate for the quarter was around ₹102.
Entered into Framework Agreement, Offtake Agreement, and Service Agreement with Pirelli Tyre S.p.A. to manufacture Pirelli PCR tyres at Bhuj and incorporate a 50:50 manufacturing JV by Dec 31, 2030.
Signed strategic agreement with Pirelli for off-take production of up to 800,000 premium car tyres by 2030, with phase two envisaging a 50-50 JV plant.
Entered into offtake agreement with Pirelli to supply up to 800,000 Pirelli-branded passenger car tyres annually by 2030 from the Bhuj plant.

timeline.summary: ARVIND PODDAR, on behalf of Balkrishna Industries Limited’s promoters and promoter group, confirmed no encumbrances on shares as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,932.82 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹257.09 Cr.
2026-05-08: Investor presentation targets 2.2x revenue to ₹23,000 Cr by FY30 and discloses a further ₹2,000 Cr board-approved capex, taking the programme to ₹6,800 Cr till FY29.
Balkrishna Industries held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, discussing record OHT volumes, new product rollouts, and an expanded ₹6,800 Cr capex plan through FY29.
Entered into Framework, Offtake, and Service Agreements with Pirelli Tyre S.p.A. for Bhuj PCR contract manufacturing and a proposed 50:50 JV in India by 2030.
Pirelli and BKT signed an agreement to manufacture up to 800,000 Pirelli tyres by 2030 and plan a 50:50 High Value tyre JV.
Balkrishna Industries entered into a strategic offtake and joint venture framework agreement with Pirelli Tyre S.p.A. on October 22, 2026, to manufacture premium passenger car tyres at Bhuj.
